title: Konti yanjye
description: Amakuru yawe, ijambobanga ryawe n'ibikoresho winjiriyeho.

fields.phoneHint: Ikoreshwa na bagenzi bawe kugira ngo bakugereho. Ntiyigera yerekwa abanyamuryango.

details.title: Amakuru yawe
details.description: Amazina n'ururimi byawe bigukurikira kuri mudasobwa iyo ari yo yose winjiriyeho.

password.title: Ijambobanga
password.description: Rihindure igihe cyose ukeka ko hari undi waribonye.
password.signsOutOtherDevices: Guhindura ijambobanga bigusohora ku bindi bikoresho byose. Iki gikomeza kwinjira.

devices.title: Ibikoresho winjiriyeho
devices.description: Sohoka ku gikoresho utazi, cyangwa kuri mudasobwa isangiwe wasize wihuta.
devices.emptyBody: Winjiye hano gusa, ahandi nta ho.
